about.title: About the project
about.lead: BookKeep is a catalog of adapted books in English and Finnish. There are no lessons or exercises here: you open a book and read it in the browser.

purpose.title: Why it exists
purpose.text: A textbook gives rules and drills. An original novel is often too dense if the language is not yet fluent. Adaptation sits between them: you read a continuous story at a level you can already hold, without a dictionary on every line.

adaptation.title: What an adapted book is
adaptation.text: It is not a short retelling and not a set of dialogues. It is the full work, with denser grammar, rarer words and long periods brought to a chosen CEFR level. Plot, characters and structure stay. What changes first is the language.

languages.title: English and Finnish
languages.text: Books in the catalog are English and Finnish only. Those are the languages of the texts. The interface can be switched to Finnish, English, Ukrainian or Russian: site labels change, the book stays in the language of the adaptation.

levels.title: Levels A2, B1, B2 and C2
levels.text: Each title has a level. A2 is clearer and shorter. B1 and B2 sit closer to ordinary fiction. C2 is almost unadapted, but still written with a language learner in mind. Take what you can read calmly, not the highest badge.

reading.title: How reading works
reading.text: In the catalog you can filter by language and level. The book opens on the site: pages, zoom, light or dark paper. No account is required. The last page is stored on this device — it will not follow you to another browser on its own.
